title: These highlights do not include all the information needed to use CEFTAROLINE FOSAMIL FOR INJECTION safely and effectively. See full prescribing information for CEFTAROLINE FOSAMIL FOR INJECTION. CEFTAROLINE FOSAMIL for injection, for intravenous use Initial U.S. Approval: 2010

sections.contraindications: Ceftaroline fosamil for injection is contraindicated in patients with known serious hypersensitivity to ceftaroline or other members of the cephalosporin class. Anaphylaxis has been reported with ceftaroline.
sections.adverse_reactions: The following serious adverse reactions are described in greater detail in the Warnings and Precautions section Hypersensitivity Reactions [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)] Clostridioides difficile-Associated diarrhea [see Warnings and Precautions (5.2)] Neurological Adverse Reactions [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3)] Direct Coombs’ Test Seroconversion [see Warnings and Precautions (5.4)]
sections.boxed_warning: Ceftaroline Fosamil for Injection is supplied in single-dose, clear glass vials containing: 400 mg - individual vial (NDC 60505-4946-1) and carton containing 10 vials (NDC 60505-4946-0) 600 mg - individual vial (NDC 60505-4947-1) and carton containing 10 vials (NDC 60505-4947-0) Ceftaroline fosamil for injection vials (unreconstituted) should be stored at 25°C (77°F); excursions permitted to 15ºC to 30ºC (59°F to 86°F) [See USP Controlled Room Temperature].
